user_story: As a user, I want to navigate through the multi-level dropdown menu so that I can access different functionalities easily. Acceptance criteria: 1. The menu should display options: 'Disabled', 'Should not see this', 'Enabled', 'Downloads', 'PDF', 'CSV', 'Excel', and 'Back to JQuery UI'. 2. Clicking on 'PDF' should navigate to the corresponding PDF download link. 3. The 'Disabled' option should be visible but not clickable.
